title: Photographer
summary: Introduce your photographic practice, present a coherent picture series and named projects, then explain how to commission you.

notFor: Videographers whose work lives on a video platform (start from creator)

cards.purpose: Identify the photographic practice, working area and commission scope before any media.
A coherent selection of photographs, shown whole with descriptive alt text and captions.
Three or four named series or commissions with context and portfolio destinations.
The next step for a commission, using only confirmed availability.
The complete portfolio and selected professional channels.

slots.ask: What name do you publish under?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji. This appears in the About popover, not beside the name; repeat the essential purpose in the first text card.

slots.ask: How would you describe your photographic practice and featured series? Where do you work, which commissions do you take, and which clients may you name?
slots.write: Start with a short heading and one paragraph about the practice and selected series. Then add working area, commission scope and client or print details only when supplied and approved. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What title identifies this body of work? A series name or a short description is enough.
slots.write: Use their supplied series title or a short description of the selected work, at most 100 characters. Replace the demonstration title; if they have no title, omit it. Do not infer a theme from the pictures.

slots.ask: Which six to twelve pictures best show your work now?
slots.write: The member uploads each picture in the editor. Per picture: alt = what is in it, for someone who cannot see it; caption = place and year, or the title they use. Ask; never guess what a picture shows. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback. Keep each uploaded image’s original aspect ratio, add a descriptive title for the set, and use fit=contain. The images block is schema-supported but not yet shown in the current app; keep the first text card and portfolio links useful without it.

slots.ask: Do you have series or commissions you want to show, each with a cover picture?
slots.write: tag = Series, Long-term series or Commission · client; title = their title; description = one line on what it is about. Select up to four featured entries for this page; link to the complete archive or catalogue instead of deleting the person’s remaining work. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: How should people commission you: a booking page, a call, email?
slots.write: Keep the presets (hire, book-call) that match a URL they give you; publish an email only if they confirm it may be public. The first button is the main one. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Which portfolio sites or social accounts should be linked?
slots.write: The account URL only; the current app shows the host and path when no label is supplied. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a photo, artwork or logo you want to upload as the profile picture?
slots.write: The person uploads their chosen picture in the editor. Never fetch, generate or infer a personal photo. Use their description for alt text wherever the editor asks for it.
